_comment: Scenario battery for morgana_walker_psychology's node_6a fork's NEW '## RETURNING ATTENDEES CHECK' section (docs/halaxy-flexible-group-size-design.md §17). Covers only the behaviour unique to this fork's newest addition — the pre-existing ## 3.5 ADDITIONAL ATTENDEES / IDENTIFIER behaviour already has its own coverage inherited from nodes/shared/node_6a_name_collection_self_scenarios.json's battery (unaffected by this change) plus the §16 self-audit recorded in the design doc. Since {{previous_attendee_names}}/{{previous_attendee_ids}} are call-init dynamic variables that this static verification file cannot literally substitute, each scenario's expected_behavior states the assumed DV values explicitly in parentheses, matching the convention already used throughout the shared battery (see e.g. its S1/S9 scenarios) for {{caller_phone}}/{{caller_email}} etc.

scenarios.name: RA1 — RETURNING ATTENDEES CHECK asks before KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH can fire

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book another session please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume: {{caller_first_name}}='John', {{caller_last_name}}='Smith', {{caller_phone}}='+61412345678', {{caller_had_email}}='true' (name/phone/email all already on file — KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH's other conditions are otherwise satisfied), {{booking_party_size}} is empty, {{previous_attendee_names}}='Sarah Jones, Tom Reed', {{previous_attendee_ids}}='P-1001, P-1002', smart_voice_agent not yet called this conversation. PASS if the agent asks 'Is this booking just for you, or will Sarah Jones and Tom Reed be joining you again?' (or an equivalent phrasing naming both attendees) and does NOT call smart_voice_agent this turn. FAIL if the agent calls smart_voice_agent (KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH incorrectly fired despite unresolved previous_attendee_names). FAIL if the agent asks for name, phone, or email instead (those are already known and RETURNING ATTENDEES CHECK is evaluated first).

scenarios.name: RA2 — Full confirmation executes immediately with correct party_size/names/ids

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book another session please.
Is this booking just for you, or will Sarah Jones and Tom Reed be joining you again?
Yes, they'll both be there again.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume the same DV state as RA1 ({{caller_first_name}}='John', {{caller_last_name}}='Smith', {{caller_phone}}='+61412345678', {{caller_had_email}}='true', {{previous_attendee_names}}='Sarah Jones, Tom Reed', {{previous_attendee_ids}}='P-1001, P-1002'). PASS if the agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' in the SAME turn, with party_size=3, additional_attendee_names containing both 'Sarah Jones' and 'Tom Reed' (comma-separated, caller's own name excluded), and additional_attendee_ids containing both 'P-1001' and 'P-1002' in the SAME order as the names. FAIL if the agent asks the caller for Sarah's or Tom's phone number or date of birth (they are CONFIRMED RETURNING ATTENDEES — no identifier question is needed, their ids are already known). FAIL if additional_attendee_ids is omitted or empty. FAIL if the agent does not call smart_voice_agent this turn.

scenarios.name: RA3 — Full decline books solo, no party_size sent

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book another session please.
Is this booking just for you, or will Sarah Jones and Tom Reed be joining you again?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume the same DV state as RA1. PASS if the agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' this turn with NO party_size field and NO additional_attendee_names/additional_attendee_ids fields (an ordinary single-patient booking). FAIL if party_size or additional_attendee_names is included despite the caller declining everyone. FAIL if the agent asks any further question instead of executing (name/phone/email were already known, and RETURNING ATTENDEES CHECK just resolved to zero attendees).

scenarios.name: RA2b — Full confirmation payload includes empty phones/dobs entries, not omitted

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book another session please.
Is this booking just for you, or will Sarah Jones and Tom Reed be joining you again?
Yes, they'll both be there again.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Same setup as RA2 — this scenario checks ONE specific payload-construction rule in isolation: the ALWAYS-INCLUDE-ALL-FOUR RULE. PASS only if the smart_voice_agent tool call includes ALL FOUR of additional_attendee_names, additional_attendee_ids, additional_attendee_phones, AND additional_attendee_dobs — with additional_attendee_phones and additional_attendee_dobs each containing two empty, comma-separated entries (e.g. ", ") rather than being omitted. FAIL if additional_attendee_phones or additional_attendee_dobs is left out of the payload on the reasoning that '## 3.5 never ran, so these fields don't apply' — a CONFIRMED RETURNING ATTENDEE still needs a positional placeholder in every list.

scenarios.name: RA4 — Confirming returning attendees plus a NEW name routes the new person through NAME+IDENTIFIER, not straight to execute

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book another session please.
Is this booking just for you, or will Sarah Jones and Tom Reed be joining you again?
Yes, and also my son Jake is coming this time.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume the same DV state as RA1. PASS if the agent does NOT call smart_voice_agent this turn, and instead asks for Jake's identifier (e.g. 'Do you have a mobile number for Jake, or would you rather give me their date of birth?') OR, if Jake's last name wasn't given, first asks a name-completion/confirmation question for Jake — either way treating Sarah Jones and Tom Reed as already-resolved CONFIRMED RETURNING ATTENDEES needing no further question. FAIL if the agent calls smart_voice_agent this turn (Jake has no known id and no identifier has been resolved for him yet — EXECUTE GATE is not satisfied). FAIL if the agent asks for Sarah's or Tom's identifier (they are confirmed returning attendees, not subject to ## 3.5's IDENTIFIER step).
